title: Olivia Rodrigo’s Daisy Chain Fields Festival Has No Overlapping Sets: See the Full Schedule
summary: The pop superstar will headline the all-women fest later this month, the schedule for which has been published.
contentText:
Olivia Rodrigo takes the pain out of the festival experience with Daisy Chain Fields — the inaugural edition has no overlapping sets.

The pop superstar will headline the all-women fest later this month, the schedule for which has been published (check it out below).

Rodrigo and her “special guests” will perform from 8:40pm-10pm on the Dandelion Stage, her start time giving fans a good 10 minutes to complete the walk from Not For Radio ’s set at the Marigold Stage (7:50pm-8.30pm).

Performers on the day include  Chappell Roan , Garbage , Doechii , The Breeders , Mitski , Bikini Kill, KATSEYE and others. Those “special guests” include Karen O , Sarah McLachlan and Stevie Nicks .

View this post on Instagram

Daisy Chain Fields will be presented Saturday, Aug. 29 at Great Park in Irvine, Calif. Its founder previously confirmed that 100 percent of the net proceeds would go to charities dedicated to advancing and advocating for women and girls.

“The lineup is truly insane and full of my heroes and friends,” Rodrigo said with the festival announcement in June . “I firmly believe that joy, community, and music can be the drivers of meaningful change and I’m hopeful this festival will be just that.”

Beneficiaries include the organizations Baby2Baby, Black Mamas Matter Alliance, Center for Reproductive Rights, FreeFrom, Jhpiego, Johns Hopkins Center for Indigenous Health, National Domestic Workers Alliance, National Institute for Reproductive Health, National Women’s Law Center and Planned Parenthood. 

Four tiers of ticket prices were made available, from $255 (general admission) up to $1,255 (pit viewing). The waitlist is at daisychainfields.com.

The day-long fundraiser is the latest in Rodrigo’s tireless efforts to make the world a better place for women and girls. In 2024, she launched her Fund 4 Good to raise money for reproductive rights, education and actions against domestic violence, later announcing that she had donated  more than $2 million  to charities through proceeds raised on her Guts World Tour . In 2025, Planned Parenthood presented her with its  Catalyst of Chang e  award.

Rodrigo will hunker down for a long stint on the road with her Unraveled Tour , which will visit arenas for multiple night stands in North America, Europe and the United Kingdom this fall and winter beginning with a Sept. 25 show at PeoplesBank Arena in Hartford, Conn, and wrapping up May 10, 2027 at The O2 in London, England.

Those dates come in support of her third studio album,  you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love , which opened at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 in June, her third consecutive leader after GUTS  (in 2023) and  SOUR  (2021). With Pretty Sad , Rodrigo enjoyed career-best opening weeks in the Unites States, the United Kingdom (where it debuted at No. 1, completing a perfect three-from-three), and elsewhere.
